scope: Present exterior keep, raised entrance stair and reconstructed low collar-wall remains. Interior rooms and the distant Terrasstrapporna are outside this asset.

publishedDimensions.finding: City summary gives approximately35 m main height and15 m square plan, an octagonal stair turret, a privy projection and surrounding collar-wall remains.

Operator labels floors8/14/20/26 m and terrace35 m; labels are not assumed to share the exterior ground datum. The seaward royal window was installed1894, and the southeast oratory has a long lancet and circular opening.

Plan and pre-restoration section on printed p45; floor surveys p46. The southwest stair turret and northwest privy establish orientation. Historical sections do not establish restored1893–94 battlements.

The2002 preservation plan records34.5 m to the upper crenellations, walls up to4 m thick, hard-fired iron-rich brick,1893–94 repairs and roof-terrace rebuilding2001. Text and photographed elevation on this page were inspected.
The city explicitly distinguishes the approximately35 m main residential tower from the attached stair turret. No surveyed38.5 m stair-turret dimension is claimed.
